Let’s take a closer look at how our frosty game has been progressing during the last few months.First closed playtestLast week marked the end of the first closed playtest for Frostrail. events.title: Sign Up for the Playtest
events.summary: Today’s blog brings you news of our upcoming closed playtest. In the time since we held a limited playtest back in November, development has steadily progressed to a point where we have a solid core experience and foundation for our game. This means that we are ready to get Frostrail into the hands of a larger number of players. events.title: Frostrail Reaches 300,000 Wishlists
events.summary: We’re delighted to share that Frostrail has now been wishlisted over 300,000 times on Steam!A huge thank you to everyone who has taken the time to add Frostrail to their wishlist. It means a lot to the team, and we’re incredibly excited to see so many of you looking forward to getting your hands on the game.We’ve also just released a brand-new gameplay trailer, so be sure to check it out if you haven’t already.Stay tuned for more news and reveals in the coming months!

events.title: Watch The New Frostrail Gameplay Trailer
events.summary: Your train is your lifeline. The tracks are your only way forward.Watch the brand-new gameplay trailer for Frostrail, a ruthless open-world survival crafting FPS from FakeFish, creators of Barotrauma.Explore, scavenge, craft, and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world alone or in co-op. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train as you push through an unforgiving wasteland where every stop, every encounter, and every decision can mean the difference between survival and the end of the line.

This year has been action-packed for our studio. Let’s talk a little bit about this game that we at FakeFish and Shiro Games have been working on for a couple of years already, behind the scenes. Frostrail is the upcoming second game of FakeFish, the Finnish game studio behind the submarine simulator Barotrauma.
